parameters.help_en: The ID of the file system
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access point
parameters.name: access_point_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the access point
parameters.name: access_point_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the permission group.

This parameter is required when the destination file system is a General-purpose NAS file system.

Default permission group: DEFAULT_VPC_GROUP_NAME (the default permission group for VPCs).
Not supported by Agentic file systems
parameters.help_zh:
权限组名称。

当目标文件系统为通用型NAS，此参数必填。

默认权限组：DEFAULT_VPC_GROUP_NAME（专有网络默认权限组）。
Agentic文件系统不支持
parameters.name: access_group

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the RAM policy.
Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled. This is the default value.

After you enable the RAM policy for the access point, all Resource Access Management (RAM) users are denied from using the access point to mount and access data by default. You must configure authorization to grant the corresponding access permissions to the accounts and mount the file system through the access point. If this feature is disabled, the access point allows anonymous mounting.

Not supported by Agentic file systems
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用RAM策略。
取值：

true：开启
false（默认值）：不开启

启用接入点RAM策略以后，缺省禁止所有RAM账号使用接入点挂载和访问数据，您需要为账号进行授权开放对应访问权限，并通过接入点进行挂载访问。禁用后，接入点允许匿名挂载。

Agentic文件系统不支持
parameters.name: enabled_ram
